name: Brash
source:
The leader of Santo, a village exclusively for warriors. He is the father of Ciera and Yuras, although it appears that his amount of concern for them is close to nil.

He appears to be extremely daunting, terribly fitting with his personality. Heavily inclined towards violence, he won't hesitate to harm the innocent just to get what he wants. His family members are no exception.
